earlier_scan.source_named: ILV/SIL Mexico 2007. Diccionario ilustrado en el zapoteco de Aloapam (and 2002 San Isidro Aloapam version); sil.org blocked download (not reachable by automated download)
earlier_scan.note: only dictionaries with likely pronunciation notes exist; Zapotec varieties are tonal

sources.citation: SIL International language page for zaq (www.sil.org/resources/search/language/zaq), Internet Archive copy 2015-09-07: full list of 18 SIL archive items for Aloápam Zapotec
sources.note: Inventory only: readers, riddles, number book, alphabet charts, vowel colouring book, the 2-page Ortografía (2001), two picture dictionaries. No grammar, phonology sketch or dictionary with grammar notes exists in the SIL archive list for zaq.

sources.citation: Nellis, Neil & Jane Goodner Nellis (comps.). 1983. Diccionario zapoteco de Juárez (Atepec, Ixtlán), with Bartholomew, Doris, 'Gramática zapoteca'. Vocabularios Indígenas 27. México: ILV.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nearest fully described sister variety (Sierra de Juárez Zapotec, zaa) with explicit tone/stress description; useful as a proxy or for the identity note, but it is a different glottocode (sier1250-area), not Aloápam.

sources.citation: Radin, Paul. 1925. The distribution and phonetics of the Zapotec dialects: a preliminary sketch. Journal de la Société des Américanistes 17: 27-76. [Glottolog ref 103699]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Lists 'Aloapa' among the Serrano pueblos ('All the puebloes in this group form a fixed unit with the exception of Abejones, Aloapa and Xia', p.30) and says of Zapotec generally 'The vowels are characterized by the possession of pitch accent' (p.31) and mentions 'loss of old pitch accent' (p.34); no statement on where word stress falls in any variety, and no Aloápam-specific phonetic remarks.

sources.citation: Bibliographic database searches for 'Aloápam/Aloapam': Lingmex (El Colegio de México), Dialnet, CIESAS institutional repository, CrossRef, OpenAIRE, DOAJ, Zenodo, archive.org full catalogue, Persée; Glottolog 5.1 sources.bib a full-text search for stress/accent
sources.note: Zero linguistic works on Aloápam Zapotec beyond the SIL literacy items and Radin 1925.)

sources.citation: Ca Tisa gue Tata Jesucristuha: El Nuevo Testamento, zapoteco de Aloápam. 1a ed. 2020, Wycliffe Bible Translators; versión electrónica 2022 (scriptureearth.org). 724 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No alphabet or pronunciation preface/appendix (checked front matter, back matter and a full-text search for stress/accent acento/alfabeto/pronuncia). The practical orthography marks an acute accent on some vowels (sitá, bilátia, Gualíba, esíaya, carbáru), implying accent is written where not default, but no rule is stated.

sources.citation: Current SIL Language & Culture Archives listing for Aloápam Zapotec [zaq] (https://www.sil.org/resources/search/language/zaq), items added after 2015
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Only a 2015 snapshot of the inventory could be read; a post-2015 grammar sketch, 'Propuesta de convenciones para escribir..' (Marlett series, with phoneme appendix) or vocabulario for zaq would supersede everything found. Needs a browser session past the an automated-access block.

sources.citation: Valverde V., Marilyn (asesora lingüística). 2013. El alfabeto en el zapoteco de Aloápam (hojas). Versión electrónica. Instituto Lingüístico de Verano. 39 pp. [SIL archive 52842]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. One letter/digraph per page with a keyword and picture (a, aa, a'a, b, c, ch, d, dh, e, ee, e'e.. x, xx, y, yy); no notes on accent or tone.

sources.citation: Valverde V., Marilyn (comp.). 2007. Diccionario ilustrado en el zapoteco de Aloápam. 2a ed. México, D.F.: Instituto Lingüístico de Verano. 26 pp. [SIL archive 12922; Glottolog ref 87889]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Image-only picture dictionary arranged by semantic field; one-page Introducción about purpose only; no alphabet, tone or accent note. Orthography writes acute accents on some vowels (rixú, númiru, xbiná, nári) without explanation.

sources.note: Alphabet chart sometimes carries a back-page 'notas' on accent/tone writing; low expectation but cheap to check once sil.org is reachable.

sources.citation: Thiessen, Grace. 2001. Ortografía: zapoteco del noroeste de Ixtlán. Versión preliminar. México, D.F.: Instituto Lingüístico de Verano. 2 pp. (SIL Language & Culture Archives entry 60662; file)
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: no other copy located; the open copy could not be downloaded when a reader tried
sources.note: The only item in the entire SIL zaq inventory written by the field linguist that addresses the sound system/orthography; if any first-hand sentence on accent or tone marking in Aloápam Zapotec exists in print, it is here (explains the acute accent used in the NT orthography).
